full_judgment: Md. Abdul Wahhab Miah, J. This Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal has been filed by a pre-emptor against the judgment and order dated the 24th day of July, 2014 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1402 of 1995 making the Rule absolute. Facts relevant for disposal of this petition are that predecessor of the petitioners as pre-emptor filed an application before the Assistant Judge, Patuakhali under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and tenancy Act, 1950 for pre-emption of the case land. In that case the purchasers, the seller were impleaded as opposite party No. 1, 2 and 3 respectively, the other co-shares were made parties as opposite party No. 4-62.
